LanguageData.RM_Wreckage_Setting_SalvageLoot_Tip: When a colonist carefully deconstructs a wreck, it gives up extra parts on top of its normal materials. Off: wrecks give only their normal deconstruction materials, like a vanilla ship chunk. Smashing a wreck never gives loot either way.
LanguageData.RM_Wreckage_Setting_SkillScales_Tip: A skilled salvager is far more likely to recover a rare part intact (Construction skill for now). Off: every salvager has the same chance.
LanguageData.RM_Wreckage_Setting_WreckFields_Tip: Scatter salvageable wrecks on new maps of the biomes that have a wreck field. Affects new maps only: wrecks already on a map stay. Off: no biome scatters wrecks.
LanguageData.RM_Wreckage_Setting_Field_Tip: Scatter wrecks on new {0} maps. Affects new maps only.
LanguageData.RM_Wreckage_Setting_WreckFalls_Tip: Let wreckage fall from the sky as an event, landing salvageable wrecks on the map. Off: no wreck-fall event ever fires. Wrecks that already landed stay.
LanguageData.RM_Wreckage_WreckFallMessage: Wreckage is falling from the sky. It will be salvageable once it lands.
